remarks: Set in Costa Mesa's Wimbledon Village, this 4 bed, 3 bath residence blends dramatic soaring ceilings with private outdoor living. Past the gated courtyard and 3-car garage, discover two-story vaulted ceilings, skylights, and wood flooring. The kitchen features a center cooktop island, granite counters, and solid cabinetry, opening directly to a vaulted family room with a contemporary fireplace. A main floor bedroom and full bath provide ideal flexibility. Upstairs, wood floors lead to a sprawling primary suite with built-ins, mirrored wardrobes, and an ensuite bath with a soaking tub and glass shower. The private backyard retreat features an in-ground circular jacuzzi, integrated bench seat
